name: Brunhild Ironvow

inventory.notes: Her mother's plate, refitted at the Ironvow forge; the left pauldron still shows the dent from the Drowned Forge
Bears the Hearthsmith's anvil, hammered in silver
Holy symbol of the Hearthsmith, worked into the shield's boss
Never far from her; she mends the party's gear at every long rest
Bone dice from the barracks; she cheats, badly

inventory.item: Trophy: a drow hand crossbow, broken
inventory.notes: Taken in the Underdark skirmish that cost her company its captain

appearance: Broad as a doorway and a head shorter than anyone else in the room. Copper braids knotted with iron rings, one for every oath kept; a burn scar across the jaw that she refuses to have healed.
backstory:
Brunhild was born in Karrgrund to a family of armourers who had forged plate for three generations of the garrison and never once worn it. She broke that tradition at sixteen, enlisting as a shield-bearer, and rose to shieldsergeant through the long years of tunnel patrols beneath the Grey Teeth.

Everything changed in the deep tunnels below the Drowned Forge. Her company was ambushed by drow raiders; the captain fell, and Brunhild held a collapsing passage alone until the wounded were carried out. She says she does not remember the last hour of that fight — only a voice, steady as a hammer on an anvil, telling her she was not finished yet. She took it for the Hearthsmith's, and swore her oath at the forge-altar the morning after.

Now she travels the surface to find the drow war-band that broke her company, and to learn whether the voice meant to save her or to send her somewhere. She keeps the soldier's habits: up before dawn, armour oiled, every promise written into her journal and struck through only when kept.
notes: Oath of Devotion tenets she quotes most: Honesty and Protection. Uses Divine Smite on anything that hurt a companion this round. Fighting style: Defense — counted in her AC, as Aura of Protection is in her saves.
